en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of cultivated fields in the foreground with a low townscape in the distance. On the right side stands a prominent church building with a tower and spire, identified as Antonius Kerk along the Groesbeekseweg. The layout and typography suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. Text captions appear below the image, including the city name Nijmegen.
